decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp multi-sample offset around indices 618–624 in N/E/U, possibly a transient shift; (2) a large, sustained displacement beginning near index 692 and continuing to the end, involving all three axes with abrupt onset and persistent deviation. Other parts show noisy but generally smooth motion.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample drop in N and E components around index 620–623, with U also decreasing; appears as a rapid offset rather than smooth motion. Preceded by relatively stable behavior and followed by continued drift, suggesting possible temporary displacement or data artifact.

Large, sustained excursion in all axes starting near index 695: N drops sharply from ~-10 to ~-22, E shifts from ~10 to ~-4, U falls from ~-14 to ~-15. The change is abrupt over ~5 samples and persists—suggests major event (e.g., jump or prolonged deformation). Includes several nulls at end but the onset is clear and warrants inspection.
